name: desktop-art-direction-fit
goal: Keep the default art direction fully visible in expanded game-view settings at every viewport

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Visual review 2 rejects mobile multiple, readonly and settings-open captures: the default art-direction final line is cut by a two-row textarea.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing GameViewFields cases checked presence and enabled/read-only controls, while review wrongly accepted clipping as scrolling. Add a post-capture scrollHeight/clientHeight guard to the same nine viewport cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 8842389acc72939a7ba63fba1d54d7124a95dd1726610b0e2662af6f980ed2b0; six desktop/tablet cases pass, all three mobile cases fail the actual content-versus-client-height assertion after capture.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Give art direction four rows so the unchanged default text fits fully at mobile width, including read-only settings. No prop/default contract or styling changes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 7737f62d06eeccddf142f359adf43911bd6093b5d672be31a33d991c1c03a63f; all nine unchanged cases pass at the fix commit with the same frozen profile. Every green PNG inspected; all mobile default text is completely visible.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
